author: Owenfpk
quote: Thirteen years.I waited thirteen years for **** they handed me a joke.Story’s a mess. Ridiculous. Nobody asked for this soft, tangled soap opera. They took the one thing GTA always was freedom, chaos, the ugly truth of the streets and replaced it with something that feels like it was written by people who never lived any of it. Strayed so far from the point it’s not even the same animal anymore.Graphics look expensive. That’s the only thing that works. Everything else feels wrong. Controls, missions, the way the world reacts. It doesn’t play like a GTA. Feels stiff. Safe. Distasteful. Like they sanded off every sharp edge so nobody gets offended.Rockstar looked at the people who stuck around through every delay, every trailer, every promise… and decided we weren’t worth the real thing. Complete disregard. A slap in the face.I’m not angry the way kids get angry. I’m just done. This isn’t the game we waited for. It’s a pretty shell with nothing inside.1 out of 10.That’s all it deserves.
